PCG ASSISTS IN FIRE RESPONSE IN PAROLA COMPOUND

The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) assisted in response operations after a fire broke out at the Parola Compound in Delpan, Binondo, Manila on Saturday afternoon, the agency said in a post on Sunday.

The fire started around 2:50 p.m., prompting the Bureau of Fire Protection and volunteer groups to deploy 55 fire trucks, while the PCG sent floating assets including boats from its fleet and the Coast Guard District NCR-Central Luzon.

PCG personnel also provided first aid to affected residents as fire authorities brought the blaze under control at around 12:15 a.m. Sunday, BFP said.

📸 PCG
